verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents proxy support with authentication, automatic retry across a proxy chain with a fallback fetch, and pairs these with stealth and undetected-browser modes for bot-protected sites, so a developer can plug in their own residential or datacenter proxies. Missing for 10: no evidence of a bundled premium residential or datacenter proxy network (bring-your-own only), no in-depth proxy configuration docs or rotation details beyond one-line feature mentions, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of bypass success.
